description: This Java class 'QueryResult' encapsulates the result of query commands within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It implements the 'Result' interface, stores a command and a response header, and provides methods for string representation and visitor pattern acceptance.

classes.name: QueryResult
classes.description: A final class representing the result of a query operation, parameterized with an event type, implementing the Result interface, holding the command issued and response headers.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the QueryResult, including class name, command, and response headers.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a ResultVisitor and invokes its onQuery method with the stored command and response.
